top_signals.title: EU proposes €45 billion Ukraine loan, to be repaid after Russia pays reparations
top_signals.summary: The European Commission on Wednesday proposed a new €45 billion ($49.5 billion) loan to Ukraine to help fill a funding gap of €70 billion for next year as Kyiv continues its fight against Russia's 2022 invasion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Copper Rebounds After Rout as Physical Tightness Persists
top_signals.summary: Copper staged a partial recovery following a steep drop on Wednesday, as traders weighed whether a sharp unwinding of bullish bets tied to artificial intelligence and US tariffs has gone too far.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: China Airport Greetings Show How Xi Views Trump, Putin, Takaichi
top_signals.summary: When Xi Jinping broke nearly five decades of norms to give Donald Trump a personal welcome at Shenzhen airport, China’s top leader explained his nation is one “of etiquette with a tradition of reciprocity.”
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Lawmakers call on White House to develop defensive AI cyber systems
top_signals.summary: A bipartisan Senate duo urged the White House to launch a national effort to more robustly confront AI-enabled cyber threats in light of recent security incidents involving artificial intelligence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Israel launches ground operation in central Gaza as dozens flee
top_signals.summary: The ground advance came as the body overseeing the truce accused Israel and Hamas militants of not meeting their commitments to end hostilities.
